sources.title: AlphaBot2 - Waveshare Wiki
sources.snippet: The AlphaBot2 smart car development kit includes a baseboard AlphaBot2-Base and an adapter board (one of AlphaBot2-Ar, AlphaBot2-Pi, and AlphaBot2-PiZero). By choosing different adapter boards, the car can support access to Arduino, Raspberry Pi 3B, and Raspberry Pi Zero W.
